title: Which Differences Matter? Controlled Tests of Rule Transfer, Joint Reliability, and Information Use in Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.30045v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decision models map stated rules and observed states to discrete answers. Aggregate accuracy leaves unresolved which rule and information changes guide those answers. We connect controlled input changes to transfer, joint reliability, and directed information use through executable arithmetic rules. Semantic rule separation and crossed rule and state tests make transfer and joint success separately measurable. We compare equivalent wordings, calibrate joint correctness through marginal-preserving reassociation, and alter tables to define alternative answer targets. Adaptation gains increase with nearest-source answer agreement; fully conflicting quartets yield small pooled gains and different gain signs across source splits. Equivalent rewrites have opposing task-level effects, linking transfer gains to rule presentation. Joint-score departures depend on which rule and state associations the reference preserves. A decision service change

translated_title: 哪些差异是重要的？决策模型中规则迁移、联合可靠性与信息使用的受控测试
translated_abstract: 决策模型将陈述的规则和观察到的状态映射为离散的答案。总体准确率无法回答是哪些规则和信息变化引导了这些答案。我们通过可执行的算术规则，将受控的输入变化与迁移、联合可靠性以及定向信息使用联系起来。语义规则分离以及规则与状态的交叉测试使得迁移和联合成功可以被分别测量。我们比较等价的措辞表述，通过保持边际分布的重新关联来校准联合正确性，并通过修改表格来定义替代答案目标。适应增益随最近源答案一致性增加而提高；完全冲突的四元组仅产生较小的合并增益，且在不同源分割下增益符号不同。等价改写在任务层面产生相反的效应，说明迁移增益与规则的呈现方式相关。联合分数的偏离取决于参考保留了哪些规则与状态之间的关联。决策服务的变更……
tldr: 本文提出一个基于可执行算术规则的受控测试框架，将决策模型的规则迁移、联合可靠性与定向信息使用分离开来加以测量，并揭示适应增益取决于最近源答案一致性、等价改写会产生相反的任务级效应、以及迁移增益与规则呈现方式密切相关。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a controlled testing framework using executable arithmetic rules that separately measures rule transfer, joint reliability, and directed information use in decision models, showing that adaptation gains increase with nearest-source answer agreement, equivalent rewrites have opposing task-level effects, and transfer gains are linked to rule presentation.
